method_notes: All 14 media_url values re-fetched with curl -sIL from the Higgsfield sandbox: HTTP 200, content-length identical to the hunter's and to Commons imageinfo size; the 8 files under 6 MB were downloaded in full and their SHA-1 matched the Commons-registered SHA-1 (gen1, gen2dog, gen2wave, gen3, swans, painting, hailuo, unk). ffprobe of all 14 URLs confirmed width/height/fps/duration/audio-stream claims.

Commons wikitext, extmetadata, upload log, templates, categories, deletion-request mentions and uploader contribution lists re-read via the Commons API (User-Agent set). YouTube licence rows for the 4 YouTube-sourced files re-read independently from Wayback captures (fetched over http:// because https to web.archive.org failed from the sandbox); page video-id, title, channel handle, date text and 'License' metadata row all match the Commons source template.

Model/date primary sources re-fetched: Stability AI (SD public release, SVD), Runway research pages (Gen-1, Gen-2, Gen-3 Alpha), THUDM/CogVideo README and arXiv API (2408.06072 published 2024-08-12), MiniMax news post, CompVis LICENSE, CogVideoX-5b LICENSE, SVD LICENSE.md, Runway ToS Wayback captures (2023-03-31, 2023-07-20, 2024-09-03), Hailuo ToS Wayback 2024-12-23 and current Hailuo subscription terms.

No frame of any clip was viewed. Two Higgsfield video_analysis results (SD park 480p transcode; CogVideoX painter) were completed at verification time and were read as unverified tool descriptions only (they invent audio for silent clips). Overlay checks are pixel-statistics heuristics (static + high-gradient pixels in corners/bands); they cannot detect burnt-in subtitles or semi-transparent marks and are NOT a substitute for viewing.

Gen-2 public-availability date (June 2023) and Gen-1 web availability remain secondary-only; the Runway research pages carry only 'Feb 2023' labels. Gen-3 Alpha page is an announcement (2024-06-17), not a release date.
